# FOO 0.2.2

**Release type:** FOO

**Git tag:** `foo-v0.2.2`

FOO 0.2.2 completes installer-managed removal on Windows and Debian. Windows
adds a visible Start Menu uninstaller, while Debian package removal now cleans
the system-managed Zig backend without touching projects or per-user data.

See `CHANGELOG.md` for the complete release notes.
